column1: # Module 06 — repo archaeology. Format: Text<TAB>tags. Card law: anki/CARD-RULES.md
Archaeology passes, in order: {{c1::signs}} · {{c2::map}} · {{c3::doors}} · {{c4::one vertical slice}} · {{c5::crown jewels}} · {{c6::verdict}}.
One vertical slice beats skimming because {{c1::one true end-to-end trace teaches the architecture}}.
Entry point = {{c1::where execution starts}} — mains, routes, service starts, scheduled tasks.
psoc-portal: every request first hits {{c1::app/src/proxy.ts — the middleware auth gate}}.
A server action {{c1::runs on the server from a form call}} and {{c2::re-checks auth — the browser is never trusted}}.
A migration = {{c1::a numbered SQL file changing the DB's shape}} — the sequence is the schema's history.
Server component {{c1::runs on the server, ships HTML}}; client component {{c2::runs in the browser, handles interaction}}.
A Windows service = {{c1::a background program the OS runs from boot, no window}}.
monk-mode's watchdog is a separate program because {{c1::a killed process can't resurrect itself}}.
monk-mode's 10-second tick: {{c1::read config}} → {{c2::verify HMAC}} → {{c3::classify heartbeat}} → {{c4::Hold/Lift}} → {{c5::re-apply block + kills}}.
Fail-closed = {{c1::on any doubt, choose the SAFE state}} — monk-mode keeps blocking.
Atomic-write pattern: {{c1::write a temp file completely, then swap it in}}.
monk-mode's weak cipher is acceptable because {{c1::the threat is tampering, not secrecy — the HMAC does the real work}}.
HMAC (preview) = {{c1::a keyed signature — without the key, no valid stamp}}.
Partner code stored as a PBKDF2 hash because {{c1::verifiable but not recoverable}}.
The TODO-grep lesson: {{c1::read grep results before believing them}} — psoc's 0 real, monk-mode's 13 false positives.
Every dig ends by {{c1::explaining one REAL audit finding in your own code}}.
